snippet.title: Dirt Digger - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Dirt Digger is out now. Buy the game here: https://www.zirtola.com

A digging game where the dirt is real. Work an Alaska placer claim with an excavator, a dozer, a wheel loader and a dump truck, find the gold sitting on the bedrock, run it through your wash plant, clean up the sluice and sell it in town. Build walls that hold the dirt back, move your plant when the ground runs out, and do it all on keyboard and mouse or a controller.

It's early, and it's being built in the open. Come tell us what you'd want next on the forum at https://www.zirtola.com

Watch how it was made, from the first build: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQIpAE5RQP4Y
